# Astronomical 0.2.77
## OpenAI-compatible request validation
Agent harnesses that send the documented `strict` field on tool definitions no longer have their sessions aborted: the field is accepted on both the Chat Completions and Responses surfaces, and the requested value is recorded. `store: false` (or an omitted `store`) on Chat Completions requests is likewise accepted; only an explicit `store: true` remains a named rejection, because Astronomical never retains server-side copies of your requests.
## Memory ceiling and residency
- Raising the memory ceiling now restarts the streaming worker into the resident engine when the raised ceiling admits residency, so the new ceiling takes effect without a full daemon restart cycle. - Request records report the true memory high-water mark by folding in every observed peak window. - The built-in updater stays dormant during unbundled development launches, so development runs never race the public update feed.
## Compatibility
- All changes are backward compatible: previously valid requests remain valid, and validation only becomes more permissive on fields the OpenAI specifications document. - Upgraded installs keep their existing models, caches, and settings.
## Distribution
This release is distributed as a Developer ID-signed, notarized DMG with Hardened Runtime and secure timestamps. The Sparkle update feed and the DMG are Ed25519-signed, and every published artifact is digest-bound: the GitHub release, the manifest, and the public feed all agree on names, sizes, and SHA-256 digests.
